body:
### What happened

A cleanup issue in hearsay-tools/cezarion (hearsay-tools/cezarion#3131) gave its acceptance list as one `npm test -- ...` command. Some arguments were directory-style prefixes, as Vitest accepts them: `packages/cezar/src/workflows/worker-reboot`, `packages/cezar/src/workflows/worker-restart` and `packages/cezar/src/workflows/ci-wait`. Each prefix matches several test files (for example `worker-reboot-*.test.ts`). An agent tried to read Squeal's verdicts for that list instead of running Vitest a second time, as the repository's instructions say. Squeal reported that these three selections match no closure. Their files were not selected, and no verdict came back for them. The agent had to expand each prefix to explicit test file paths by hand before Squeal could answer for the list.

### What you expected

A named selection that Vitest's CLI accepts as a path filter, such as a directory prefix, selects the same test files in Squeal. If Squeal does not support prefixes, it should say that the argument is a prefix it does not expand, and list the files that match, instead of reporting no closure.

### Command and output

not recorded (the agent's report: "Literal prefix selections worker-reboot/worker-restart/ci-wait match no closure in Squeal; I will pass explicit test paths.")

### Squeal version

not recorded at the time; current version 0.1.423

### Squeal revision

10

### Harness

Codex (a Cezar worker task)

### Model

gpt-6.1-sol-fast

### Cost

About 1 turn per affected slice, plus one acceptance check that first returned no verdict for three of the selected groups. The same prefixes appear in the acceptance lists of hearsay-tools/cezarion#3130 and hearsay-tools/cezarion#3131, so each slice that reads Squeal for its list repeats the expansion.

### Did a daemon restart clear it?

Not tried.

### Suggested fix

Resolve a selection that is not an exact test file path as a Vitest-style path filter (substring or prefix match over the discovered test files), and report the files it expanded to. If that is out of scope, return a specific message for a prefix that matches discovered files: "this is a path prefix; Squeal selects exact files: <matching files>".
title: Directory-style test selections that Vitest accepts match no closure
